}}'''Sanor''' is a crewman aboard the ''[[Gray Gull]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sanor}}

==Appearance==
Sanor is a large man with arms as big as [[Perrin Aybara]]'s.

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] hastily board the ''Gray Gull'' in [[Tar Valon]], Sanor and [[Vasa]] are ordered by [[Huan Mallia]] to throw them overboard. The captain reconsiders when he sees Mat's coin.{{ref/book|3|32}} Sanor guards the gangplank from refugees when the ship arrives in Aringill.{{ref/book|3|40}}
